facts.fact: Gabriel牵着Aurora穿过彩绘玻璃长廊远离宴会，停在流星彩窗前点破她：质问她究竟想谈留下的事，还是想用“跟这世上他最恨的seraph（Darragh）跳舞”来分散他的注意力。
facts.anchor: “Did you want to talk to me about staying, or are you still trying to distract me from your disobedience and dancing with the one seraph I hate the most in this world?”

facts.fact: Aurora辩解：请Darragh跳舞是因为他救过她的命、在练武房护她免于烧伤、昨晚爆炸致她脑震荡后送医，她至少欠他一支舞；Gabriel冷答“你不欠他什么，他只是在执行保护你的任务”。
facts.anchor: He saved my life in the city, protected me from burns in the sparring room, and got me to a healer last night after the explosion gave me a concussion.

facts.fact: Aurora开始就留下提问：能否在城堡内设草药学研习之处；Gabriel答只要能留住她，愿把城中一整间店面都给她。
facts.anchor: For starters, am I able to set up a place within the castle to practice herbalism? It is of great importance to me that I continue to bolster my skills.

facts.fact: Aurora追问Torrish国王与Mollah王后是否知道Gabriel邀她们母女留在城堡，Gabriel答“当然知道”。
facts.anchor: “Do King Torrish and Queen Mollah know you have asked us to remain in the castle?”

facts.fact: 回应Aurora对Cora与她自身安全的担忧（提到之前的窃贼与昨日民兵袭击），Gabriel承诺她不在他身边时任何时刻都配不止一名卫兵；Aurora说要时间考虑，为Cora做大决定不能轻率。
facts.anchor: I know you had an unfortunate run-in with a thief and then yesterday with that militia attack, but I will ensure you have more than one security guard at any given time when you aren’t with me.

facts.fact: Gabriel说“吻我”后强吻推进，把Aurora压在大理石墙上、探手入裙；她起初顺势随后欲望骤冷，几次要求停下而Gabriel充耳不闻、抓着她不放——她被性侵的记忆闪回、呼吸加剧。
facts.anchor: “Gabriel, please. I want to stop.” My breathing intensified as the memory of my assault flashed before me.

facts.fact: Darragh赶到，把Gabriel猛地拽开甩到对面墙上，一句“Lady Aurora请你停下，Commander”带着杀意，随即温声问Aurora是否无恙。
facts.anchor: “I believe Lady Aurora asked you to stop, Commander,” Darragh spoke with the promise of violence laced in his words.

facts.fact: Gabriel狂笑指控Darragh是因嫉妒而对她动心，逼近到咫尺宣称“她是我的！”；Darragh回敬“Rory不属于任何人，更不属于你”，挨了一拳、嘴唇裂开又迅速愈合，舔血冷笑问“好受些了吗”。
facts.anchor: Gabriel stepped up to Darragh, mere inches from his stony face. “She is MINE!”

facts.fact: Aurora夹在两人中间爆发：她身在异国、刚得知包括亲生父亲在内的族人正被seraph从Edenalee抓来此地，而最可能帮她的两人却在斗气；她喊出自己害怕、为Cora安全担忧、没被认真对待、现在很愤怒，随后甩手回房，只想洗掉Gabriel的手与唇的痕迹。
facts.anchor: I just learned that my people, including my own father, are being taken from Edenalee and brought here by seraphs, and all anyone says about it is ‘I’ll look into it,’ or I am deceived into thinking I am crazy.
